categories.title: Mineral Deposits & Geology
categories.tagline: Where the rocks are, what they hold, and how they got there.
categories.description: Bedrock maps, mine registers, geochemistry, heat flow, and lithological lexicons — the foundational geological layer for every mineral intelligence workflow. Combine regional surveys (OneGeology, BGS, SGU) with national occurrences (MRDS, ARDF, SAMINDABA) and global geochemistry (EarthChem, Mindat) to triangulate from continent-scale tectonics down to deposit-scale paragenesis.

categories.title: Earth Observation & Satellite
categories.tagline: Eyes in the sky that see what no permit filing ever will.
categories.description: Optical, SAR, methane, fire, and forest-loss constellations turn the planet into a daily-updated verification layer. Cross-check mine permit boundaries with Sentinel-2 disturbance footprints; watch tailings dam creep with ICEYE SAR; quantify undocumented artisanal mining via PlanetScope tasking. Earth Observation is the only layer that independently confirms what companies, governments, and news o...

categories.title: Mining Operations & Production
categories.tagline: Who mines what, how much, at what cost, and from where.
categories.description: Asset-level production, reserves, cost curves, tailings inventories, and corporate ownership. The layer that converts geological potential into economic reality. Combine with commodity prices for NPV calculations; combine with satellite imagery for production verification; combine with shipping data for export reconciliation.

categories.title: Commodity Prices & Financials
categories.tagline: The instantaneous economic engine that turns rocks into revenue.
categories.description: LME, COMEX, SHFE, LBMA, Fastmarkets, Argus, Platts — every benchmark price that values mining output. Combined with mine cost curves, this layer converts geological data into NPV surfaces; combined with shipping data, it predicts trade-flow redirection; combined with company filings, it surfaces earnings surprises before announcements.

categories.title: Company Filings & Disclosures
categories.tagline: The legal-paper trail of what companies say they have and what they're doing.
categories.description: NI 43-101, JORC, SAMREC, SEC 10-K, SEDAR+ filings, EITI revenue reports — the regulated disclosure layer that converts corporate claims into auditable text. Combined with satellite imagery for verification, with cost curves for sanity-checking, and with commodity prices for valuation, this layer surfaces discrepancies between company claims and ground truth.

categories.title: Shipping, Logistics & Trade
categories.tagline: Where the metal actually moves — the physical truth-teller.
categories.description: AIS vessel tracks, port arrivals, bilateral trade statistics, freight rates. The shipping layer is the verification layer: if a mine claims X production but ships 0.7X, someone is lying. Combined with mine production data and commodity prices, this layer surfaces trade-flow redirections in real time and predicts warehouse stock changes weeks ahead.

categories.title: ESG, Environmental & Social
categories.tagline: The non-negotiable social licence to operate.
categories.description: GRI, SASB, CDP, TNFD, IRMA audits, protected areas, biodiversity proximity, ESG ratings. The layer that converts environmental performance into investable signals. Combined with satellite imagery for verification and with corporate filings for disclosure alignment, this layer surfaces greenwashing and reputational risk before they hit headlines.

categories.title: Geophysics, Seismic & Hazards
categories.tagline: The deep-earth physics that explains where deposits sit and where disasters strike.
categories.description: Earthquakes, volcanoes, magnetics, gravity, space weather. The layer that gives the third dimension and the dynamic hazard frame. Combined with mine locations for risk assessment, with heat flow for geothermal potential, and with seismic stations for exploration targeting, this layer protects operations and unlocks blind deposits.

categories.title: Infrastructure, Energy & Water
categories.tagline: The grid, the rails, the pipes, and the power that mining depends on.
categories.description: Power plants, transmission, rail, water, energy mix. The layer that determines whether a deposit is mineable. A high-grade Cu deposit 500 km from grid power and 100 km from rail is uneconomic regardless of grade. Combined with mine cost curves, this layer surfaces stranded-asset risk and energy-transition opportunities.

categories.title: Meteorology & Climate
categories.tagline: Weather, climate, and the long-term atmospheric envelope mining operates in.
categories.description: Open-Meteo, NOAA Climate, ERA5, WorldClim, NASA POWER. The layer that constrains operations daily and shapes strategy annually. Combined with water data for flood risk, with satellite imagery for cloud-free planning, and with climate models for 30-year asset resilience, this layer prevents weather-related production losses and surfaces climate-resilient assets.

categories.title: Academic, Research & News
categories.tagline: The knowledge graph of mining — papers, critical-mineral lists, news.
categories.description: USGS and EU critical-mineral lists, World Bank, OECD, Mining.com, Reuters Metals. The layer that frames the policy and narrative context. Combined with supply-demand models for trade-policy intelligence and with company filings for news-driven trading signals, this layer surfaces policy-driven market moves before they hit prices.

categories.title: Live Operational Telemetry
categories.tagline: The real-time pulse of the moving world — satellites, transit, traffic, radio.
categories.description: CelesTrak satellites, GTFS transit, GBFS bikeshare, radio stations, traffic, routing. The layer that proves a Cesium globe is alive — operational data flowing every minute. Combined with mine and shipping layers, this enables contextual intelligence: when satellite AIS gaps align with vessel transponder silence, the question 'what are they hiding?' becomes answerable.

personas.name: Mine General Manager
personas.summary: Runs the whole mine — production, cost, safety, community. Reports to the COO; accountable for everything below ground and above.

personas.name: Open Pit Engineer
personas.summary: Designs and optimises open pit shells — pushback sequencing, final wall design, haul road geometry.
decisions: Final pit shell vs. intermediate phases

personas.name: Underground Mine Engineer
personas.summary: Designs underground layouts — decline, level spacing, stoping method, ventilation. Balances dilution vs. recovery.

personas.name: Drill & Blast Engineer
personas.summary: Designs blast patterns — hole spacing, burden, explosive type, timing. Optimises fragmentation and minimises damage.

personas.name: Mine Planner
personas.summary: Builds short-, medium-, and long-term mine schedules. Optimises NPV through cut-off grade and sequencing.

personas.name: Mine Surveyor
personas.summary: Maintains the spatial integrity of the mine — pit pickups, underground surveys, deformation monitoring.

personas.name: Heavy Equipment Manager
personas.summary: Manages truck/shovel fleet — availability, utilisation, maintenance scheduling. Optimises payload and fuel burn.

personas.name: Shift Operations Manager
personas.summary: Runs the shift — coordinates crews, resolves bottlenecks, hits the daily tonnage target.
decisions: Stop work vs. continue on safety concerns

personas.name: Process Plant Metallurgist
personas.summary: Optimises the concentrator — recovery, throughput, reagent consumption. Diagnoses metallurgical anomalies shift-by-shift.

personas.name: Mineral Processing Engineer
personas.summary: Designs and troubleshoots comminution, flotation, magnetic separation, leaching circuits.

personas.name: Refinery Manager
personas.summary: Runs the smelter or refinery — anode furnaces, electrorefining, leach-EW. Manages concentrate blend and metal accountancy.

personas.name: Extractive Metallurgist
personas.summary: Develops hydromet vs. pyromet route selection. Designs leach, SX, EW circuits for new deposits.

personas.name: Plant Maintenance Engineer
personas.summary: Keeps the plant running — preventive maintenance, breakdown response, reliability engineering.

personas.name: Geotechnical Engineer
personas.summary: Slope stability, foundation design, ground support. Designs for the rock mass, not the ore body.

personas.name: Tailings Dam Engineer
personas.summary: Designs, operates, and closes tailings storage facilities. Post-Brumadinho, the most-watched engineering role in mining.

personas.name: Hydrogeologist
personas.summary: Manages mine water — dewatering, supply, contamination plume tracking. The most-permit-sensitive engineering role.

personas.name: Rock Mechanics Specialist
personas.summary: Numerical modelling of rock mass response — FLAC, UDEC, 3DEC. Caving methods, in-situ stress, induced seismicity.

personas.name: Tailings Closure Planner
personas.summary: Designs the post-mining landform for tailings facilities. Covers, vegetation, long-term water management, financial assurance.

personas.name: HSE Manager
personas.summary: Health, Safety, and Environment — the conscience of the operation. Manages TRIR, fatalities, environmental incidents.

personas.name: Environmental Scientist
personas.summary: Manages air, water, biodiversity monitoring. Permit compliance, EIA updates, rehabilitation monitoring.

personas.name: Rehabilitation Specialist
personas.summary: Designs and implements post-mining rehabilitation — recontouring, soil replacement, revegetation, ecosystem restoration.

personas.name: Occupational Health Officer
personas.summary: Manages worker health — dust exposure, noise, vibration, fatigue, mental health.

personas.name: Logistics Manager
personas.summary: Coordinates mine-to-port-to-customer supply chain. Vessel chartering, rail scheduling, port handling.

personas.name: Shipping Coordinator
personas.summary: Day-to-day vessel operations — nomination, loading, demurrage, documentation. The execution layer of bulk logistics.

personas.name: Port Operations Manager
personas.summary: Runs the loading port — berth allocation, stockyard management, shiploader throughput, draft constraints.

personas.name: Supply Chain Analyst
personas.summary: Maps the full supply chain from mine-to-customer. Identifies bottlenecks, concentration risk, alternative routes.

personas.name: Procurement Manager
personas.summary: Sources goods and services for the mine — explosives, reagents, fuel, tyres, capital equipment.

personas.name: Commodities Trader
personas.summary: Trades physical and derivative metals. Needs to anticipate warehouse stock changes, trade flows, and supply disruptions.

personas.name: Marketing & Sales Manager
personas.summary: Sells mine output — concentrate, cathode, doré. Manages customer relationships, contract terms, offtake.

personas.name: Supply Demand Analyst
personas.summary: Builds supply-demand balances per commodity. Forecasts deficits, surpluses, and price implications.

personas.name: Market Intelligence Analyst
personas.summary: Tracks competitor activity, M&A, project pipeline. Produces market-context briefings for the commercial team.

personas.name: Contract Structuring Manager
personas.summary: Structures offtake, streaming, royalty, and tolling agreements. Manages price-risk and credit-risk allocation.

personas.name: Equity Research Analyst (Mining)
personas.summary: Covers mining equities for sell-side or buy-side. Builds NAV models, forecasts earnings, recommends Buy/Sell.

personas.name: M&A Investment Banker
personas.summary: Advises mining clients on M&A — buy-side, sell-side, joint ventures. Runs auctions, valuations, and fairness opinions.

personas.name: Project Finance Banker
personas.summary: Structures debt financing for new mine projects. Manages credit risk, offtake quality, completion guarantees.

personas.name: Mining Private Equity
personas.summary: Invests equity in mining projects/companies with the goal of 3–5x return over 5–7 years. Distressed, growth, and buyout strategies.

personas.name: Hedge Fund Commodity Analyst
personas.summary: Generates alpha via commodity and equity positioning. Uses proprietary signals from alternative data.

personas.name: Mining Company CFO
personas.summary: Manages the mining company's finances — capital allocation, hedging, treasury, financial reporting, investor relations.
decisions: Dividend vs. buyback vs. debt reduction

personas.name: ESG Analyst
personas.summary: Rates mining companies on ESG performance. Identifies laggards, leaders, and rating-divergence cases.

personas.name: Sustainability Manager
personas.summary: Implements the company's sustainability strategy. Manages reporting, target-setting, stakeholder engagement.

personas.name: Biodiversity Specialist
personas.summary: Manages biodiversity risk and offsets. Implements TNFD, mitigates impacts on protected areas and Key Biodiversity Areas.

personas.name: Community Relations Manager
personas.summary: Manages the social licence to operate. Stakeholder engagement, grievance mechanisms, local employment, community development.

personas.name: Mining Cadastre Officer
personas.summary: Manages the mining-claim register. Approves, suspends, and cancels licenses; collects rents and royalties.

personas.name: Geological Survey Director
personas.summary: Runs the national geological survey. Publishes official maps, manages public-domain datasets, advises on resource policy.

personas.name: Critical Minerals Policy Advisor

personas.name: Mining Insurance Underwriter
personas.summary: Underwrites mining insurance — property, business interruption, tailings liability, political risk. Prices risk per site.

personas.name: Political Risk Analyst

personas.summary: Academic researcher studying ore deposits. Publishes in Economic Geology, Mineralium Deposita, etc.

personas.summary: Studies the economics of mineral supply — cost curves, supply elasticity, substitution, recycling. Works at universities, IEA, World Bank.
